extra.reason: Scaffolded and verified: engine (schema/sim/observer), play CLI+MCP, web app, demo game, 8 passing tests, prod build clean
Rng class with next/int/chance/pickWeighted + getState/fromState, 5 tests

catalog.ts: Zod schemas (TypeChart/Move/Species/Catalog) + validateCatalog with fix-naming errors (unknown types/moveIds/evolution targets, dup ids, unsorted learnset, missing level-1 move, bad multipliers). Decisions: type chart supports PARTIAL coverage — missing pairs default to 1.0 so only non-neutral matchups need listing; single atk/def pair so physical/special is descriptive; move effects kept minimal as one-stage raise_/lower_ atk/def/spd (raise targets self, lower targets opponent) so status moves do something. Helpers: speciesById, moveById, statsAtLevel (hp=floor(2b*L/100)+L+10, others +5), movesKnownAtLevel (last 4), typeMultiplier. Fixture test/fixtures/catalog.json: 6 types, 13 moves, 8 species incl emberling->pyrewyrm line, mosskrag dual rock/grass, puddlit. 11 catalog tests pass.

battle.ts: deterministic Battle class, all randomness via injected Rng. Damage floor((floor((2L/5+2)*power*atk/max(1,def))/50+2)*stab*typeMult*roll), STAB 1.5, roll U[0.85,1.0], min 1 dmg when typeMult>0. Turn order by stage-modified spd, rng tiebreak. Escape chance clamp(0.5+0.1*(pSpd-eSpd)/max(1,eSpd), 0.1, 0.95) using stage-free spd, wild only. PP decrements; 0-PP move rejected without consuming round; all-PP-exhausted falls back to built-in Flail (normal/20/never misses). Faint -> needsSwitch free switch (no enemy hit); voluntary switch gives enemy a free attack; enemy auto-replaces. Swappable EnemyAi (default random valid move). state fully JSON-serializable with outcome ongoing/player_won/enemy_won/fled. 15 battle tests pass incl determinism, effectiveness ratios, STAB, seeded miss/run, trainer-forbids-run.

battleObserve.ts: describeBattle renders mode+round, both actives with glyph/name/level/types/10-char HP bar, enemy party count, numbered move list with type/category/power/PP, party summary with active/fainted marks, last events, outcome line, and context-sensitive Actions line (run only in wild; switch-only when a faint forces it; Flail note when all PP gone). Covered by 2 dedicated tests plus battle tests; all passing.

Multi-map overworld shipped: maps record with per-map rows/entities/portals/encounters, portal validation + transfer, wild-tile encounter zones with seeded RNG (Sim(game, seed), snapshot() incl. rng state), pendingEncounter gating + resolve action, observer shows map/exits/encounter, demo migrated to village + east-road with emberling/puddlit table, play/web updated. 57 tests pass, validate + scripted win + vite build verified.

Sourced CC0/CC-BY assets (Zelda-like tileset+chars by ArMM1998 CC0; battlers by Antifarea and Redshrike CC-BY 3.0, licenses in apps/web/public/assets/LICENSES.md). Built zod sprite-manifest schema+loader, canvas renderer (16px tiles at 3x, rAF anim clock, animated water/tall-grass, 120ms tile tweening, facing walk/idle anims, clamped camera follow), and /sprites.html demo verified headless (no console errors) plus vite build passing multi-entry.

Wild-tile hits now construct a wild Battle immediately (shared Rng, party by reference); battle actions gated both ways (move1..4/m, switch1..6/s, item1..9, catch/snare, run); outcomes flow back (victory->XP/evolution, defeat->heal+respawn+half money, fled); pendingEncounter/resolve removed; snapshot() includes battle state and is JSON-round-trippable; determinism through battles covered by tests (79 passing).

Party (max 6) via player.party + give_species; catching p=clamp(catchRate*ballMod*(1.3-hp/maxHp),0.05,0.95), full-party catches gently released; XP floor(xpYield*enemyLevel/5) on enemy faint, cubic L^3 curve, level-ups recompute stats (heal by HP gain) and learn learnset moves replacing the OLDEST of 4; evolution checked at battle end keeping hp fraction. Demo migrated with embedded catalog + Elder gift; all state serializable.
